name: Submit and look up DocupletionForms forms with an AI agent

parameters.content:
## Submit and look up DocupletionForms forms with an AI agent

![Workflow overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alfa-intellitech/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms/main/templates/images/ai-agent-for-docupletionforms.png)

**Uses the verified [n8n-nodes-docupletionforms](https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms) node — available on n8n Cloud and self-hosted instances.**

### Who's it for
Teams who want to fill out or check [DocupletionForms](https://docupletionforms.com) submissions through a chat interface (a Slack bot, an internal chat widget, or the built-in n8n chat) instead of opening the DocupletionForms app.

### How it works
A chat message triggers an AI Agent with two DocupletionForms tools attached: one submits a form with field values the agent extracts from the conversation, the other looks up existing submissions for a form. The agent decides which tool to call based on what the user asks for.

### How to set up
1. Add your OpenAI credential to the Chat Model node.
2. Add your DocupletionForms credential to both DocupletionForms tool nodes, and pick the Form each one should use.

### Requirements
- n8n (Cloud or self-hosted) with `n8n-nodes-docupletionforms` installed — on Cloud, enable it under Settings → Community Nodes; verified nodes are approved for Cloud installs.
- A DocupletionForms account and API key.
- An OpenAI API key (or swap in any other n8n Chat Model node).

### How to customize
Attach more DocupletionForms tool instances (Generate Prefilled Link, List Document Sets, Download Merged Document) the same way — add the node under the agent's Tool port and pick the Resource/Operation you want to expose.

### Step 1
Set up your OpenAI credential here (or swap in a different Chat Model node).

### Step 2
Set up your DocupletionForms credential on each tool node below and pick the Form it should use.
